dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast perimeters. A central 'O' structure shows a sharp gradient transition from the dark charcoal substrate to a light-grey irregular boundary. A dorsal 'C' structure displays a jagged, high-contrast upper edge with a fading lower gradient. A posterior-lateral 'O' structure features a thicker, more diffused light-grey ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters; most patterns are annular. A few localized, low-intensity solid black clusters are present in the ventral-posterior region without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary central 'O' annulus and the two adjacent 'C' structures form a non-equilateral triangle with the vertex pointing towards the dorsal ridge. Relative distances between the three most prominent centroids are approximately equal, creating a near-isosceles configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a yellow-brown, linear organic object (vegetation) adhering to the lower posterior skin surface.
